name: Virtual Analog Dual
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Emilie Gillet's original virtual-analog variant 0: independently shaped oscillators, interval detuning, and sync.

controls.label: Detune and sync
controls.description: Detunes the secondary oscillator and sweeps the synchronized alternate-output ratio.

controls.label: Primary waveform
controls.description: Changes the primary oscillator from saw through square and pulse shapes.

controls.label: Secondary waveform
controls.description: Independently changes the secondary oscillator across the same waveform range.

controls.label: Detune range
controls.description: Scales interval detuning around the original range at its midpoint.

outputs.main: Equal mixture of the primary and detuned secondary oscillators.
outputs.aux: Equal mixture of the primary and hard-synchronized secondary oscillators.

upstream: Mutable Instruments eurorack Plaits source, original VA_VARIANT 0 with Plaits Palette macro and stereo integration
